title: Jovial Malaysian Noodle Dish
description: A lazy Sunday Malaysian dish featuring a grassy flavor profile and a cheese-pull texture, made with sunflower oil and folded noodles, suitable for Jain-friendly diets.
instructions: Heat sunflower oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start browning.
Add grassy scented soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add rice noodles and folded wheat noodles to the pan, stirring to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Add vegan mozzarella shreds on top of the noodles and cover the pan with a lid to melt the cheese.
Remove the lid and use a spatula to gently fold the noodles and distribute the melted cheese.
Sprinkle chopped scallions, sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper over the top of the noodle dish.
Serve the jovial Malaysian noodle dish hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
